post.description:
Cocktails for one book (`book_id`) or a reader's taste (`book_ids`, liked and
avoided genres), with reasons. Children's and young-adult books, `alcohol_free` and
an alcohol-free `cocktail_preferences` get alcohol-free recipes only.

One evening for an occasion: an outfit (when fashion is served), a book and a drink
the pairer pairs with it, each with its reason, plus a 'why it works' line. A part
the server cannot plan is listed in `missing` with the reason.

Change one part of the evening the client holds: another or a cheaper outfit piece,
another book (its drink is re-paired) or another or an alcohol-free drink.

AgentStep.title: AgentStep
AgentStep.description: One observable step of a turn, streamed to the UI as it happens.

BecauseYouLiked.title: BecauseYouLiked
BecauseYouLiked.description: Recommendations seeded by books the reader liked ("Because you liked …").

BookEffect.title: BookEffect
BookEffect.description: Approved books for the reading list, or remembered reading tastes.

BookPreferences.title: BookPreferences
BookPreferences.description: Approved, session-scoped reading tastes the client sends back with each message.

BookRef.title: BookRef
BookRef.description: A book's id, title and first author, for pickers that list the whole catalog.

ChatFeedback.title: ChatFeedback
ChatFeedback.description: A shopper's rating of one assistant answer, for offline review of agent quality.

ChatTurn.title: ChatTurn
ChatTurn.description: One earlier message, with the IDs of the cards an assistant turn showed.

CocktailEffect.title: CocktailEffect
CocktailEffect.description: Approved drinks for the cocktail shortlist, or remembered tastes.

CocktailPreferences.title: CocktailPreferences
CocktailPreferences.description: Approved, session-scoped cocktail tastes the client sends back with each message.

EmptySlot.title: EmptySlot
EmptySlot.description:
A slot the outfit could not fill, as the server reported it. Client-supplied on the
way back, so the issue and the cheapest price are only ever shown again.

EveningEffect.title: EveningEffect
EveningEffect.description:
An approved evening: pieces for the shortlist, books for the reading list and drinks
for the saved cocktails.

EveningRequest.title: EveningRequest
EveningRequest.description:
Plan an evening: an occasion in free text, plus optional limits and tastes.

A budget ("under €100") or "alcohol-free" written in the occasion counts as if given.
`alcohol_free` left out follows the occasion's words; an explicit false overrides them,
except when they make the evening alcohol-free for safety (pregnancy, kids, driving).

EveningState.title: EveningState
EveningState.description:
What the client sends back to swap a part or save the evening. The server re-reads
every product, book and recipe and re-pairs the drink; nothing here is trusted as a fact.

EveningSwap.title: EveningSwap
EveningSwap.description: Change one part of the evening the client holds.

EveningTastes.title: EveningTastes
EveningTastes.description:
The reader's remembered tastes from the other domains, applied to every part: avoided
genres and authors, liked genres, an alcohol-free taste and avoided ingredients, and a
per-piece price limit.

FashionEffect.title: FashionEffect
FashionEffect.description: An approved shortlist addition or remembered shopping preferences.

GraphNode.title: GraphNode
GraphNode.description: A node of a product neighborhood: a product, a catalog attribute or a category.

GroundingReport.title: GroundingReport
GroundingReport.description: Result of checking the final answer's claims against tool evidence.

Health.title: Health
Health.description:
Service status. The flat fashion and cocktail fields predate `domains` and stay for
existing clients; they read 0/False when that domain is not served.

OutfitQuery.title: OutfitQuery
OutfitQuery.description: Build an outfit without the assistant: the same planner the BuildOutfit tool uses.

OutfitState.title: OutfitState
OutfitState.description:
What the client sends back to swap or save pieces of the current outfit.

The server re-reads every product (and so every price) from the catalog; the client only
says which piece fills which slot. The reasons and notes it carries are display-only.

PairedGain.title: PairedGain
PairedGain.description: The learned ranker's MAP@12 gain over buy-again, with a paired bootstrap interval.

PairingRequest.title: PairingRequest
PairingRequest.description:
Pair one book (`book_id`) or a reader's taste (`book_ids` and liked genres).

`alcohol_free` and an alcohol-free `cocktail_preferences` (the cocktail domain's
remembered taste) keep only alcohol-free recipes; a children's or young-adult book always
does. Avoided genres never drive the profile; avoided ingredients are left out.

PantryMatch.title: PantryMatch
PantryMatch.description: A recipe scored by how much of it the shopper's pantry covers.

PendingAction-Input.title: PendingAction
PendingAction-Input.description:
A proposal as the API sends it: the signed fields plus display-only cards.

The server signs everything except `products`, `cocktails`, `books` and `summary`.

PendingAction-Output.title: PendingAction
PendingAction-Output.description:
A proposal as the API sends it: the signed fields plus display-only cards.

The server signs everything except `products`, `cocktails`, `books` and `summary`.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description:
The name for the UI and the agents' text ("PQ BOSTON SILK SKIRT" -> "Boston Silk
Skirt"); `name` stays the raw catalog name.

ProductGraph.title: ProductGraph
ProductGraph.description: A bounded one-hop neighborhood of a product (`/products/{id}/graph`).

QueryPhoto.title: QueryPhoto
QueryPhoto.description: A photo of an H&M garment outside the catalog, to try image search with.

query.title: Query
query.description: Visual description of the wanted item for image search, e.g. 'red floral summer dress'. Leave out price and audience.

wants_products.title: Wants Products
wants_products.description: False for small talk or questions that need no product search.

SearchIntent.title: SearchIntent
SearchIntent.description: A product search request: a visual description plus metadata constraints.

ShopperPreferences.title: ShopperPreferences
ShopperPreferences.description: Approved, session-scoped preferences the client sends back with each message.

ThemeWeight.title: ThemeWeight
ThemeWeight.description: One flavour theme of a profile: what the books say and what it pours.
